symptom: In the benchmark results drawer, the 'SELECTED ROUTE' expansion ring shows an em dash and 'Run a route to compare expansions' instead of a percentage, and stays that way, after the user picks a starting point on the map. The 'NATIVE SPEED SAMPLE' ring beside it updates correctly to the new pair, so one ring tracks the selection and the other goes blank. The route summary below likewise falls back to 'Run this route to see its details.' and the frame scrubber reads 0 / 0.
rootcause: stores/useSearchStore.ts's setCity() clears data to null on every city change (so a stale trace is never shown against a new route), but it did not itself re-run the search -- the decision to re-run lived in the caller. Only one of the two callers implemented it, and only for one of the two fields: components/search/SearchMap.tsx's chooseCity() ran `if (selectedField === "destination") run()`, so choosing a start city cleared data and nothing repopulated it. components/search/RoutePlanner.tsx's CitySearch onSelect handlers never called run() at all, so changing either dropdown blanked the ring until the user pressed 'Run search'. The two rings diverge because they read different sources: the expansion ring reads the store's live data, while the runtime ring reads public/data/all-pairs-runtime.json keyed directly off startCity/destinationCity, which is unaffected by data being null.
fix: Move the re-run trigger out of the callers and into the store, so it cannot be forgotten by a new call site: setCity() now calls `void get().run()` on both its branches -- the changed-city branch and the same-city early return, which SearchMap's caller-side guard used to cover for the destination field. components/search/SearchMap.tsx's chooseCity() drops the `selectedField === "destination"` condition and simply calls setCity(selecting, city.id). RoutePlanner needs no change: its onSelect handlers now re-run through the store for free.
notes:
Near-miss with benchmark-panel-static-runtime (runbook §7), which is the opposite ring in the same component, but a different mechanism: §7 was wired to the wrong data source (a hardcoded sample_route), whereas this is the right data source never being repopulated. Recorded separately rather than as a variant.

The reason no gate caught it is worth keeping: components/benchmark/BenchmarkPanel.test.tsx seeded the store directly (`useSearchStore.setState({ data, startCity, destinationCity })`) and so never executed setCity's data: null path, while components/search/RomaniaSearch.test.tsx clicked a start and then a destination -- the destination click fired run(), so the blank intermediate state passed through unasserted, and that test never rendered the benchmark panel. No test crossed 'select a start city' with 'benchmark ring'. Worse, RomaniaSearch.test.tsx pinned the bug as expected behaviour with `expect(mockedRunSearch).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` after the start click; that assertion was inverted as part of this fix.
